character_removal.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached full two-panel animation rig picker screenshot. Remove ONLY the rendered human character in BOTH panels: full body, hair, clothes, shoes, skin, eyes and every pixel of the character, and large face and shoulders on right. Replace the erased character with pure solid black (#000000), matching existing background. Preserve EVERY overlaid colorful controller and ALL buttons, labels, black outlines, strokes, their exact positions, dimensions, colors, wording, spacing, frame, and two-panel composition. Restore the tiny control shapes unobscured on pure black. Do not remove any red, blue, yellow, green, cyan, pink or orange controller; preserve small finger, brow, lip, eye, nose controls too. No new character, no redesign, no extra text. Same full landscape screenshot aspect ratio and framing, all edges visible. This is the control-only reference plate for a Maya picker.

frontal_repose.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: BODY ONLY background plate for an editable animation rig picker. Use the input Edward Scissorhands stylized 3D model as strict character identity reference. Preserve his exact stylized face, large worried eyes, pale skin, tangled curling black hair, dark leather buckled suit with the exact belts, metal rings and brass buckles, long scissor hands, trousers and boots. Re-pose him into a symmetric orthographic frontal A pose, looking straight at camera, spine upright, feet apart and parallel, arms down and angled outward about 25 degrees, both scissor hands clearly separated from torso, blades spread and downward. Anatomical right on viewer LEFT. Do not add normal human fingers or lose scissors. Full body on completely flat pure black background, no shadows on floor, no scenery, no text, no UI, no controller graphics. Portrait 700:1000 aspect ratio. Center body at 50% width; top of hair at 7% height; bottom boots at 93%; shoulders at 26%; elbows at 38%; wrists at 49%; pelvis at 53%; knees at 72%; ankles at 88%. Keep both hands and blades entirely visible within 12%-88% of width. Crisp premium studio 3D render with soft neutral frontal light and subtle highlights on dark leather, matching the supplied model. This is a REPOSED illustration derived from the supplied photograph, not a new design.
